description: This Java source file defines the SignalFilter class, which filters a set of targets based on authorization, subscription, and topic filtering criteria for messaging signals in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages which targets should receive signals considering permissions, subscriptions, and message filters.

classes.name: SignalFilter
classes.description: Filters a set of targets for signaling based on authorization, subscription status, and topic filters within the Eclipse Ditto messaging framework.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the set of targets in the connection based on whether they are authorized, subscribed, and match topic filters for the given signal.

methods.name: isTargetAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a target has the necessary authorization to receive signals based on its authorization context and headers.

methods.name: isTargetSubscribedForTopicGenerally
methods.description: Determines if a target is generally subscribed to the topic implied by the signal.

methods.name: isTargetSubscribedForTopicWithFiltering
methods.description: Determines if a target is subscribed to a filtered topic that matches the signal and its filters.

methods.name: applyTopicFilter
methods.description: Creates a predicate to filter topics matching the signal's extracted topic.

methods.name: applyNamespaceFilter
methods.description: Creates a predicate to filter topics based on namespaces.

methods.name: namespaceFromId
methods.description: Extracts namespace string from an entity ID.

methods.name: matchesFilterBeforeEnrichment
methods.description: Checks if a filtered topic's filter matches a signal, ignoring extra fields.

methods.name: parseCriteria
methods.description: Parses a filter string into criteria, possibly throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: topicFromSignal
methods.description: Derives the topic from a signal based on its type and headers.

methods.name: getCriterionOfSignal
methods.description: Identifies the topic criterion (e.g., commands, events, messages) based on the signal type.
